text: Training objective: This major aims to cultivate interdisciplinary and high-quality leading talents in financial technology with solid theoretical knowledge of computer science, proficient IT skills, innovative spirit, practical ability, broad international vision and rich financial knowledge.Major Features: Focusing on the combination of computer science and technology and finance, this major focuses on the cultivation of computer professionals in the field of financial technology, and focuses on the cultivation of talents with good theoretical foundation and practical ability. It is the computer science and technology major with the most distinctive financial characteristics in China.Core Courses: Object-oriented programming (JAVA SE), Object-oriented Programming (JAVAEE), Programming (C language), Data structure, algorithm analysis and design, operating system, compilation principle, database Principle and application, computer network, Introduction to Artificial Intelligence, natural language processing, cloud computing, big data technology, digital image processing, blockchain technology, etc.
